name: Olombrada (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided white over red in the proportions 2:1, the white charged with three green eradicated holm oaks in a row.
history: Olombrada adopted its arms and flag officially on 27 December 2002, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 20 January 2003; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of two horizontal stripes in the proportions 2/3 and 1/3, the upper white with three trees.

features.role: three eradicated holm oaks in a row
